infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: BPR uses the camera so you can photograph a document, a report or a scan and send it to your clinic.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: BPR needs access to your photos so you can attach an existing document or report to your clinical record.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: BPR saves a copy of documents you download from your clinical record.

plugins.faceIDPermission: BPR asks for Face ID so only you can open your clinical record on this device. Your password still works if Face ID is unavailable.

plugins.photosPermission: BPR needs access to your photos so you can attach an existing document or report to your clinical record.
plugins.cameraPermission: BPR uses the camera so you can photograph a document, a report or a scan and send it to your clinic.
